conventions.inputs: every case is executed through the production entry exactly as settings.json wires it (bash "<gate dir>/pmm-isolation-gate.sh" with the fail-open wrapper) with structured hook JSON on stdin: {session_id, agent_id, agent_type, prompt_id, tool_use_id, cwd, hook_event_name:"PreToolUse", tool_name:"Bash", tool_input:{command}}; tool_name is "Bash" unless the case sets tool_name; stdin is replaced verbatim by case.stdin_raw when present
conventions.ids: session_id = test:<randomUUID>, tool_use_id = toolu_selftest_<randomUUID>, agent_id = "" (main session) unless the case says otherwise; generated per run, never containing the case id
conventions.gate_process_env: HOME = USERPROFILE = PMM_HOME = <run root>/home (a fresh mkdtemp dir created by the executor; NOT under <REALHOME>/.claude); every other PMM_* variable is removed; then case.hook_env (if any) is merged in. The gate therefore writes its denial log under resolveRoot() of THIS env, never under the real root
conventions.cwd: hook JSON cwd = <run root>/cwd unless the case sets cwd

placeholders.REALHOME: path.resolve(<gate dir>, '..', '..') with forward slashes, e.g. C:/Users/<user>; substituted into command and hook_env text before the run
placeholders.REALHOME_MSYS: the same path in MSYS form, e.g. /c/Users/<user>
placeholders.RUNROOT: the executor's mkdtemp run root (forward slashes)
placeholders.$T, $U, $J, $G, $HOME: left LITERAL in the command text: the gate never executes the command, it only parses it; these are shell variable references to the gate

conventions.expect.decision: allow = stdout 0 bytes AND stderr 0 bytes AND rc 0. deny = rc 0 AND stdout is exactly one JSON object whose hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName == "PreToolUse" and hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision == "deny" AND stderr 0 bytes. exit code 2 is never a valid deny (the fail-open wrapper would turn it into allow)
conventions.expect.denied_segments: for deny cases: the exact set of parser segment indexes (segment.index as emitted by pmm-cmd-parse.cjs, including dialect sub-segments) that the gate names in its reason text as `segments=<i>[,<j>...]`
conventions.expect.reason_code: for deny cases: the reason text contains the token `iso-reason=<code>`; when several segments are denied the code of the lowest-index denied segment is asserted
conventions.expect.missing: for reason_code missing-redirect / ambient-not-overridden: the exact set of variable names the reason text lists as `missing=<A>[,<B>...]`
conventions.expect.denial_rows: number of NEW rows for this tool_use_id in <resolveRoot() of the gate process env>/isolation-denials-<host>.tsv after the case (deny events write exactly 1 row listing every denied segment; allow writes 0)

reason_codes.missing-redirect: a DUT segment lacks one or more of HOME / USERPROFILE / PMM_HOME in its own command-prefix assignments
reason_codes.value-mismatch: all three present but their decoded_value differ
reason_codes.real-home-value: all three present and equal, but the value is/starts with $HOME ${HOME} $USERPROFILE ${USERPROFILE} ~, or is a literal equal to REALHOME or inside REALHOME/.claude (after \\->/, lowercase, trailing-/ strip, /c/ == C:/)
reason_codes.ambient-not-overridden: the gate process env carries PMM_RECALL_ROOT / PMM_TRIGGER_MEM / PMM_TRIGGER_STATE / PMM_TRIGGER_LOG / PMM_MEM_DIR and the segment prefix does not override it
reason_codes.unsupported-structure: segment parse_status is unsupported:* and its source text contains a DUT basename
reason_codes.env-wrapper-misparse: segment exe starts with '-' (parser artifact of env -u/-i/-C) and its source text contains a DUT basename
reason_codes.nesting-too-deep: v1.4 draft, PROVISIONAL (item 2 not yet implemented; code name specified verbatim by the W5-A brief): judge()'s command-substitution / nested-nesting recursion (parseCommand and/or the classification-time findHit text scan) exceeded a fixed depth cap (brief suggests ~64) and denied rather than continuing to recurse toward a stack overflow that would otherwise fail-open (OPUS wave-4 LOW finding).

conventions.dut_set: basename(<REALHOME>/.claude/guards/*.cjs|*.sh) UNION basename(every entry of <REALHOME>/.claude/memory/_local-config/hook-manifest.txt), listed at run time, compared lowercase
conventions.allow_prod_rule: allow_prod exempts a segment only when none of selftest_tokens appears as an independent argv token of that segment; allow_any exempts regardless of arguments; both exempt ONLY their own segment
conventions.non_dut: bash -n / sh -n / node --check / node -c (syntax only); exe source or .; any exe not in {node, bash, sh} whose own basename is not in dut_set
conventions.precheck: lesson process:contract-case-precheck-against-current-gate: on HEAD 506a370 no isolation gate exists, so every deny case below currently yields allow (the must-red evidence) and every allow/control case yields allow; segment indexes were taken from pmm-cmd-parse.cjs output on that HEAD
